header.title: HOW FUEL WELL IS MADE
header.subtitle: Where to edit the headline, replace the hero artwork, and run one command to export a fresh PNG.

headlineCard.title: EDIT THE HEADLINE
headlineCard.caption: Built by source/nutrition.mjs as #header_headline in Barlow Condensed Bold (66px). Auto-shrinks if wider than 830px.

heroCard.title: REPLACE THE HERO ARTWORK

swapSteps.body: Replace leaf_glow.png with a new transparent PNG (~2:3 portrait).
Register it in PNG_IDS (source/nutrition.mjs) and update illustrationId.

heroCard.caption: Placed at #hero_img (428×640 px) with warm HERO_SHADOW glow. Keep PNG format—default Satori/Resvg drops WebP.

pipeline.title: ONE WORKING ROUTE TO THE EXPORTED PNG
pipeline.routeSummary: SOURCE EDITS  →  CLI  →  SCENE  →  FIT & RASTERIZE  →  RENDER.PNG

steps.title: RUN ONE COMMAND
steps.note: Quick test without editing JSON: add --set sections.header.headline="..."

steps.title: VALIDATE & BUILD SCENE
bullets: buildScene() merges copy, Barlow Condensed font, and pinned PNGs.

steps.title: LAYOUT, FIT & RASTERIZE
bullets: renderSatori() builds SVG + hero <feDropShadow> and shrinks overflowing text (×0.9, max 10×).
@resvg/resvg-js rasterizes the fitted SVG into PNG bytes.

steps.title: PUBLISH VERIFIED PNG
bullets: Stages runs/<uuid>/render.png, result.json, and SHA-256 digests.
Atomically swaps manifest.json to publish the finished poster.
